description: Search Google Patents or fetch single-patent details. Pick a mode and fill the matching fields.

assignee.description: Assignee or applicant company, e.g. "Google", "Apple Inc", "IBM".
assignee.title: Assignee / Company (mode=byAssignee)

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If direct fetches start returning 403 / 429, automatically retry through Apify proxy.
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate on block

citationDirection.description: Which side of the citation graph to walk: backward (cited by this patent), forward (citing this patent), or both.
citationDirection.title: Citation direction (mode=byCitation)

classification.description: CPC or IPC code, e.g. H04L9/06 or G06N3/00. The Google Patents site search uses CPC=... internally.
classification.title: Classification code (mode=byClassification)

country.description: Restrict search modes to a specific patent office. (any) = no restriction.
country.title: Filing-jurisdiction filter

fetchFullDetails.description: For search modes (searchPatents, byInventor, byAssignee, byClassification): also fetch each patent's full HTML page for abstract, claims, classifications, citations. Adds 1 HTTP request per patent.
fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full patent details

filingDateFrom.description: Drop patents filed before this date.
filingDateFrom.title: Filing date — from (YYYY-MM-DD)

filingDateTo.description: Drop patents filed after this date.
filingDateTo.title: Filing date — to (YYYY-MM-DD)

language.description: Translate the returned patent metadata to this language when Google Patents has a translation available. Patent text is multilingual; this only affects the rendered locale.
language.title: Result language

enumTitles: Lookup single patent by publication number
Search by CPC / IPC classification code
List forward / backward citations of a patent
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Used when useProxy is enabled or auto-escalation triggers.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

publicationDateFrom.description: Drop patents published before this date.
publicationDateFrom.title: Publication date — from (YYYY-MM-DD)

publicationDateTo.description: Drop patents published after this date.
publicationDateTo.title: Publication date — to (YYYY-MM-DD)

publicationNumber.description: Patent publication number, e.g. US11704715B2, EP3789012A1, WO2020012345A1, CN101234567A. The actor accepts any country prefix supported by Google Patents.
publicationNumber.title: Publication number (mode=byPatent)

publicationNumbers.description: Optional: list multiple publication numbers to fetch in one run (mode=byPatent) or to seed citation traversal (mode=byCitation).
publicationNumbers.title: Publication numbers (batch — mode=byPatent or mode=byCitation)

query.description: Free-text search query — same syntax as the Google Patents site search box.
query.title: Query (mode=searchPatents)

status.description: Restrict results by legal status of the family.
status.title: Status filter

urls.description: Direct patents.google.com URLs (search results, patent pages, or inventor / assignee search URLs).
urls.title: Patent URLs (mode=byUrl)

useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify proxy. Google Patents is generally accessible without a proxy; enable only if direct fetches return 429 / 403.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: Google Patents Scraper Input
